ocr.markdown:
Mon
Southwestern Style Bean Dip  2 cups
1 16oz can refried beans
1/2 # Pepper(Jalapeno) cheese spread, cubed
1/2 c chopped onion
1/4 c taco sauce

In small saucepan, combine ingredients; stir over
low heat until cheese melts. Serve hot w/ corn chips
or tortilla chips.
